Dave Matthews Band
March 2, 2024
Extra Innings Festival
Tempe Beach Park - Tempe, AZ

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: Zoom H1n Handheld Recorder (24/96)
Location: Approx. 100' from Stage Lip, DFC, Mic XY @ 7'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 7.11 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 24/48) > Audacity 3.4.2 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Notes:

¹ David Bowie cover
² with "Dixie Chicken" (Little Feat) interpolation
³ with "Also Sprach Zarathustra" (Richard Strauss) and "Heartbreaker" (Tom Petty) interpolations
⁴ Billy Preston cover
⁵ with Jennifer Hartswick on Trumpet
⁶ ZZ Top cover
⁷ truncated version, with "Immigrant Song" (Led Zeppelin) outro
⁸ Carter solo intro; Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation

I originally planned to cover this set with my traditional recording set up. Unfortunately, this festival has adopted a staunch anti-taping policy. Luckily, I came prepared with a different rig that I was able to get into the festival.

I accidentally set the gain level a shade too high for this recording which resulted in peaking/brickwalling. I was able to EQ the tape to sound significantly less harsh and the results are a lot better than I expected. There's still mild distortion on some Carter hits and Stefan riffs. The tape itself won't win any awards, but it's a pretty solid capture of this performance.

Huge thanks to the entire DMB organization for supporting live taping.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.

Compiled on 2024/03/08.
